page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse. Running head centred at top with page number at top right. Below the running head, a verse stanza continues from the previous page; then a woodcut ornamental band; then a centred title in capitals with subtitle; then an ode with a decorated initial H, set as verse lines.

main_text.head: HENRICO III. FRANCIÆ ET POLONIÆ REGI Christianissimo.

p.l: Te nostra gestit dicere nunc Lyra,

page.notes: The woodcut ornamental band and the decorated initial H are not text. The initial letter E in "ENRICE" is set in small capitals after the decorated H. Doubtful: "Dextrāsque" as printed may be "Dextrásque"; "tesuum" as printed reads "te suum" with the space lost in the scan; "Serua" and "Poscimus" are as printed.
